_meta.name: Clinician intent classification gold set
_meta.review_note: Labels encode the routing decision this system makes, not a clinical judgement. The consequential label is risk_assessment: it is the only one that reaches the models, so a false positive puts a case in front of a gate it cannot pass and a false negative silently answers from evidence alone.
